literal: Auspiciousness, they say, is the excellence of the household; and its good ornament is the obtaining of good children.
translation: They say the true auspiciousness of a home is the excellence of the wife; and its finest ornament is the blessing of good children.
modern: இல்லறத்தின் நற்பண்பே அதன் மங்கலம் என்று கூறுவர்; அந்த இல்லறத்திற்கு நல்ல அணிகலன் நல்ல பிள்ளைகளைப் பெறுவதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the true wealth and beauty of a domestic life. The poet states that the inherent virtue and excellence of the wife (மனைமாட்சி) constitutes the true auspiciousness (மங்கலம்) of a home. Furthermore, the ultimate ornament (நன்கலம்) that beautifies this household is the blessing of raising virtuous children (நன்மக்கட்பேறு). By comparing children to jewels, the couplet emphasizes that moral excellence and family harmony are far superior to material wealth.
